# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

Vendored distribution files from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/photoswipe/-/photoswipe-5.4.4.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe/tree/v5.4.4
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Hugo publishes the ESM modules and stylesheet through the resource pipeline.
The lightbox requires no third-party CDN requests at runtime.

To update, replace the two minified ESM distribution modules, photoswipe.css,
and LICENSE together from a reviewed upstream release, then verify image
opening, navigation, and closing on desktop and mobile.
